'''Vials of Ink''' are a rare crafting material used in the crafting of armor, particularly [[Monk armor|Monk]], [[Necromancer armor|Necromancer]], and [[Ritualist armor|Ritualist]].  

==Acquisition==
*Purchased from [[rare material trader]]s.
*Select [[artisan]]s will craft one Vial of Ink for 4 [[Plant Fiber]]s, 1 [[Tempered Glass Vial]] and 20 {{gold}}.
*Random drop from [[Hidden Treasure]] in [[dungeons]].
*[[Expert Salvage Kit|Expert salvaged]] from:
**Armor crafted with Vials of Ink.
**See [[:Category:Contains ink]] for other items.
*No [[creature]]s currently [[drop]] Vials of Ink.
